objectives.title: Point Serena at your project
objectives.why: Every symbolic tool operates on whichever project is active — this is the first thing that has to happen.

objectives.title: Let Serena onboard itself to a new codebase
objectives.why: Onboarding builds Serena's understanding of the project once, up front, instead of re-deriving it every session.

objectives.title: Get the lay of the land before diving in
objectives.why: A symbol overview of a file or directory beats opening every file to see what's in it.

objectives.title: Jump straight to a symbol instead of grepping for it
objectives.why: Finding a symbol by name and kind is precise; text search over a common word like `run` or `get` returns noise.

objectives.title: Find every caller before you change something
objectives.why: Changing a function's behavior without knowing who calls it is how you break something three files away.

objectives.title: Jump to where a symbol is actually defined
objectives.why: The call site tells you how something is used; the declaration tells you what it actually does.

objectives.title: Find every implementation of an interface
objectives.why: An interface with five implementations means a change to its contract has five places to check.

objectives.title: Edit a function by its symbol, not by line number
objectives.why: Replacing a symbol's body is stable across reformatting and unrelated edits — a line-number edit isn't.

objectives.title: Rename a symbol across the whole codebase in one step
objectives.why: A symbolic rename updates every reference consistently — a text find-and-replace risks renaming an unrelated match.

objectives.title: Insert code relative to an existing symbol
objectives.why: Anchoring a new function or import to a symbol survives the file changing shape around it.

objectives.title: Delete dead code with dependency checking
objectives.why: Deleting a symbol that's still referenced somewhere else breaks the build; a safe delete checks first.

objectives.title: Fall back to regex search when symbols aren't enough
objectives.why: Not everything is a symbol — config values, strings, and comments need pattern search instead.

objectives.title: Check for errors before calling it done
objectives.why: A change that looks right can still fail to typecheck or lint — diagnostics catch that before you move on.

objectives.title: Run a command through Serena directly
objectives.why: Running tests or a build through the same session that made the edit keeps the loop tight.

bestPractices.title: Check references before renaming or deleting a symbol
bestPractices.why: Renaming or deleting something without first seeing every place it's used is how a confident refactor breaks a caller you never looked at.

bestPractices.title: Run diagnostics after an edit, not just before
bestPractices.why: The edit you just made is exactly the one most likely to have introduced the next error — checking after is what catches it.

bestPractices.title: Onboard before you start changing an unfamiliar project
bestPractices.why: Editing a codebase Serena hasn't onboarded to yet means working from a worse map of what's actually there.
